import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_post_content(post_title: str, post_body: str) -> str: """ Formats and sanitizes a user‑submitted blog post for safe display on a webpage. Args: post_title (str): The headline or title of the blog post. post_body (str): The full text content of the blog post. Returns: str: A fully sanitized HTML string ready for rendering. """ # Escape special HTML characters to prevent XSS and ensure well‑formedness. safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Construct the final HTML using the predefined template. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
